title: Tunable Hydrogels from Pulmonary Extracellular Matrix for 3D Cell Culture
protocol: Make sterile filtered DiH2O for the decellularization process and store it at 4°C.
Under fume hood, add 100 µl Triton-X 100 Solution to 100 ml of sterile filtered DiH2O and agitate until dissolved; then sterile filter.
Prepare a sterile filtered 2% Deoxycholate solution by adding 2 g Sodium Deoxycholate per 100 ml of sterile filtered DiH2O, agitating until dissolved; then sterile filter.
Add 58.44 g NaCl to 1 L of sterile filtered DiH2O and agitate until dissolved; then sterile filter to make a 1 M NaCl solution.
Prepare DNase solution by adding 12,000 units DNase to 1 L of sterile filtered DiH2O; add 0.156 g MgSO4 (Anhydrous) and 0.222 g CaCl2; agitate until dissolved; then sterile filter.
Combine 27.2 g Na2HPO4 · 7H2O, 80 g NaCl, and 2 g KCl with 10 L of sterile filtered DiH2O; agitate until dissolved; adjust pH to 7.4; then sterile filter to make PBS.
Obtain an en bloc normal porcine lung from a slaughterhouse.
Dissect away the heart using tissue scissors or scalpel, cutting vasculature as close as possible to the heart.
Carefully dissect away connective tissue surrounding the trachea, bronchi, and remaining vasculature using a scalpel or scissors.
Determine the best lung by choosing one without large cuts or punctures through the pleura, large amounts of atelectasis, or vascular occlusion that may impede decellularization.
Cut away the suboptimal lung, leaving as much bronchus attached to the trachea as possible.
Close disconnected bronchi with clamps or suture to prevent excess backflow.
Prepare the decellularization solutions and refrigerate at 4 °C until needed.
Perfuse the lung tissue 3 times with DI water through both pulmonary artery and trachea.
Begin perfusion with around 1 L into vasculature and 1.5 L into trachea for each perfusion, increasing as cellular debris is removed.
Perfuse both vasculature and trachea with Triton X-100 solution.
Submerge lung tissue in Triton X-100 solution for 24 hr at 4 °C.
Perfuse vasculature and trachea 3 times with DI water to rinse.
Perfuse both vasculature and trachea with deoxycholate solution.
Submerge the tissue sections in deoxycholate for 24 hr at 4°C.
Perfuse vasculature and trachea 3 times with DI water to rinse.
Perfuse both vasculature and trachea with NaCl solution.
Submerge tissue in filtered NaCl solution for 1 hour at 4°C.
Perfuse vasculature and trachea three times with DI water to rinse.
Perfuse both vasculature and trachea with DNase solution.
Submerge tissue in filtered DNase solution for 1 hour at 4°C.
Perfuse both vasculature and trachea five times with PBS.
Dissect away noticeable cartilaginous tissue, trachea, and all tubules 2 mm or larger in diameter from conducting airways.
Leave only respiratory zones (primarily the peripheral areas).
Dissect tissue into 1-inch sections or smaller.
Pour off excess liquid and place tissue in 50 ml conical tubes.
Freeze the tissue at -80°C.
Remove lids from frozen tubes containing decellularized lung tissue.
Place filter paper over the tube opening and secure with a rubber band.
Ensure the tube and contents are still frozen; otherwise, return to -80°C until frozen.
Lyophilize the tissue until all excess liquid is gone using a freeze dryer according to manufacturer directions.
Store at -80°C until ready to mill.
Add liquid nitrogen to the freezer mill to cool it.
Remove magnetic mill bar from the mill tube and add tissue.
Replace mill bar, close the mill tube, and place in the freezer mill.
Fill liquid nitrogen to the max fill line.
Freezer mill all tissue into a fine powder for approximately 5 minutes at an impaction rate of ~600 min-1.
Store the powdered tissue at -80 °C until ready for use.
Add 1% (w/v) decellularized powder and 0.1% (w/v) pepsin to 0.01 M HCl under constant agitation at room temperature for 48 hours.
Place the solution on ice for 5 minutes after digestion.
Use refrigerated 10% (v/v) 0.1 M NaOH and 11.11% (v/v) 10x PBS to bring the digested protein solution to physiological pH of 7.4.
Store the adjusted solution at 4 °C for up to one week if not performing rheometry immediately.
Prepare solutions of 1%, 0.1%, and 0.01% w/v genipin by dissolving genipin powder in 10% DMSO.
Vortex the solution every 15 minutes for one hour.
Add the genipin solution to cover ECM hydrogels, using 100 µL per well of a 96-well plate.
Incubate the ECM hydrogels at 37 °C for 24 hours to crosslink.
Rinse the ECM hydrogel three times with PBS until the washing solution is no longer blue.
Refrigerate pregel solution overnight at 4 °C in a 96-well non-treated tissue culture plate to allow protein adsorption to the plate.
Aspirate the pregel solution and rinse the wells with PBS.
Add 10,000 cells/cm² to the wells.
Increase the media volume to 100 µl per well and incubate at 37 °C for cell culture.
Resuspend pelleted cells in a concentration of 1,000,000 cells/ml of pregel solution for three-dimensional cell culture.
Quickly dispense 16 µl of pregel-cell suspension into each well of a 96-well plate to form a ~500 µm thick hydrogel.
Incubate at 37 °C for 30 minutes for the gel to form.
Add 100 µl of media to the top of formed hydrogels and incubate at 37 °C.
Pipette 100 μl of pregel solution into each well of a 96-well plate.
Incubate the plate at 37°C for 30 minutes for gel formation.
Add 10,000 cells/cm² to the wells.
Increase the media volume to 100 μl per well.
Incubate the plate at 37°C.
